cross_cutting_findings.finding: Anon and authenticated have TRUNCATE and TRIGGER table privileges on most Verify tables.
cross_cutting_findings.qualification: RLS does not constrain TRUNCATE. This is a material privilege-hardening gap. The observed app code does not expose a direct SQL/TRUNCATE route; exploitability requires confirming all exposed RPCs, SQL execution surfaces and role grants.
cross_cutting_findings.action: Do not blanket revoke. Trace RPC definitions, exposed schemas, SQL execution extensions and shared app dependencies first.

cross_cutting_findings.finding: public_verification_records is intentionally publicly readable, but the browser uses SELECT *.
cross_cutting_findings.action: Constrain public receipt projection to an explicit allowlist and preserve the metadata-only envelope contract.

cross_cutting_findings.finding: api/verify/run.ts has no user-authentication check; it relies on a process-local in-memory rate limiter (8 requests per minute per IP).
cross_cutting_findings.qualification: Static code observation only. Rate-limit behavior under deployed Vercel concurrency and abuse has not been runtime-tested.
cross_cutting_findings.action: Decide whether the public demo endpoint is intentionally anonymous; if production commercial use, add durable rate limiting, abuse controls and an explicit authorization/billing policy.

cross_cutting_findings.finding: No Verify-specific Storage bucket or Storage API call was found; only private answer-scripts bucket exists.
cross_cutting_findings.action: Keep uploaded documents in the current in-memory processing path unless a separate privacy and retention design authorizes Storage.
